description: The canonical content form of a shadow comparison. Only the text fields subject, title, subtitle, body and text count, in that order. Each is masked: tracking pixels removed, links reduced to scheme, host and path, ISO 8601 timestamps to <ts>, UUIDs and prefixed identifiers to <id>, runs of at least 20 letters, digits, _ or - holding both a letter and a digit to <token>, control characters dropped and white space collapsed; money and date formats stay. The canonical form is the JSON object of the channel and the masked fields with no white space; the digest is its SHA-256 in lowercase hex.
